name: Circle-of-fifths wheel
doc: Interactive circle-of-fifths harmonic wheel displaying the 12 pitch classes in fifths order, lighting active chroma pitches, highlighting and rotating toward the estimated key, and mapping key to hue.

palette.doc: optional palette tint blended with key-to-hue OKLCh harmony

rot_speed.doc: wheel rotation responsiveness toward the estimated key

web.doc: intensity of inner harmonic interval filaments connecting active pitch classes

pulse.doc: bass and onset radial pulse strength

glow.doc: HDR glow intensity for active wedges, tonic crown, and center orb

labels.doc: show pitch-class note labels (C, G, D, A...) on the 12 wedges

key_hue.doc: blend from input palette (0) to estimated key-to-hue OKLCh color (1)
